1.6.0.title: Cards and Apple Watch
features: Cards mode: write one thought per card, then swipe through them. Cards keep their own content, settings and timer, apart from the teleprompter.
Decks show on the Lock Screen too: lock your iPhone while reading and turn cards from there. The timer comes along.
CueCard on Apple Watch: play, pause and turn cards from your wrist, see the timer, or read decks right on the watch.
Play or pause from Control Center or the Action button.
